about: What fails at the legacy 1.4.x code, one entry per defect: id (KD-NNN), ownerIssue, evidence (a GitHub link pinned to a full commit SHA, with a line anchor), tests (titles that carry the id; empty when the entry only lists uncaught messages), and optional uncaught (exact messages of exceptions the smoke tests tolerate). A listed test that passes, or a listed message that no longer occurs, fails the run, and the PR that fixes the defect deletes its entry. Harness tests are declared with test.fail(title, body), node tests with expectFailure(title, body) from test/helpers/expect-failure.js, and test/known-defects.test.js checks titles and entries match both ways. Format: e2e/harness/known-defects.js.

tests: KD-001 sidebar search for a word only in a block's text finds the note
KD-002 the capture-selection command saves the selected text and its source to today's Daily Note
